description: Create, edit, rename, duplicate, delete or read print presets, optionally capturing the active document's current print settings (File > Print Presets > Define; File > Print > Save Preset)

action.description: What to do with the preset

fromDocument.description: Start from the active document's print settings (create and update), like Save Preset in the Print dialog

name.description: The preset name (the new name for create; the existing preset otherwise)

newName.description: New name (update renames; duplicate names the copy, default "<name> copy")

settings.description: Print options to store in the preset; only the ones you pass change. Not for this tool: pageRange, preserveColorNumbers

allPrinterMarks.description: All printer's marks (Marks and Bleed > All Printer's Marks)

bitmapPrinting.description: Print as bitmap (Advanced > Print as Bitmap)

bitmapResolution.description: Bitmap printing resolution, dpi (Advanced > Print as Bitmap) (72 to 1200)

blackAngle.description: Black screen angle, degrees (Output > Inks > Angle) (0 to 360)

blackFrequency.description: Black screen frequency, lpi (Output > Inks > Frequency) (1 to 500)

bleedChain.description: Make all four bleed values the same (Marks and Bleed > chain icon)

bleedInside.description: Inside (or left) bleed (Marks and Bleed > Bleed) (mm)

bleedMarks.description: Bleed marks (Marks and Bleed > Bleed Marks)

bleedOutside.description: Outside (or right) bleed (Marks and Bleed > Bleed) (mm)

colorBars.description: Colour bars (Marks and Bleed > Color Bars)

compositeAngle.description: Composite screen angle, degrees, with custom screening (Output > Angle) (0 to 360)

compositeFrequency.description: Composite screen frequency, lpi, with custom screening (Output > Frequency) (1 to 500)

crd.description: Colour rendering dictionary name, for PostScript colour handling (Color Management > Color Handling); or DEFAULT_VALUE / USE_DOCUMENT / WORKING

cropMarks.description: Crop marks (Marks and Bleed > Crop Marks)

cyanAngle.description: Cyan screen angle, degrees (Output > Inks > Angle) (0 to 360)

cyanFrequency.description: Cyan screen frequency, lpi (Output > Inks > Frequency) (1 to 500)

downloadPPDFonts.description: Download PPD fonts (Graphics > Download PPD Fonts)

flattenerPresetName.description: Transparency flattener preset name, e.g. "[High Resolution]" (Advanced > Transparency Flattener Preset)

ignoreSpreadOverrides.description: Ignore spread flattener overrides (Advanced > Ignore Spread Overrides)

includeSlugToPrint.description: Include the slug area (Marks and Bleed > Include Slug Area)

intent.description: Rendering intent of the output colour (Color Management)

magentaAngle.description: Magenta screen angle, degrees (Output > Inks > Angle) (0 to 360)

magentaFrequency.description: Magenta screen frequency, lpi (Output > Inks > Frequency) (1 to 500)

markLineWeight.description: Mark weight: P125PT = 0.125 pt, P05MM = 0.05 mm (Marks and Bleed > Weight)

markOffset.description: Distance of marks from the trim (Marks and Bleed > Offset) (mm)

markType.description: Printer marks type, or the name of a custom marks file (Marks and Bleed > Type); or DEFAULT_VALUE / J_MARK_WITH_CIRCLE / J_MARK_WITHOUT_CIRCLE

omitBitmaps.description: Omit bitmap images for OPI (Advanced > Omit for OPI: Bitmap Images)

omitEPS.description: Omit EPS images for OPI (Advanced > Omit for OPI: EPS)

omitPDF.description: Omit PDF images for OPI (Advanced > Omit for OPI: PDF)

opiImageReplacement.description: Let InDesign replace OPI proxies with high-resolution images (Advanced > OPI Image Replacement)

pageInformationMarks.description: Page information (Marks and Bleed > Page Information)

pagePosition.description: Page position on the paper (Setup > Page Position)

paperGap.description: Space between pages on roll-fed media (Setup > Gap) (mm)

paperHeight.description: Custom paper height in mm, or "AUTO" (Setup > Height)

paperOffset.description: Offset from the left edge of the imageable area (Setup > Offset) (mm)

paperSize.description: Paper size name, as listed by get_print_settings (Setup > Paper Size); or DEFINED_BY_DRIVER / CUSTOM

paperTransverse.description: Rotate the page 90° on the media (Setup > Transverse)

paperWidth.description: Custom paper width in mm, or "AUTO" (Setup > Width)

ppd.description: PPD name, as listed by get_print_settings (General > PPD); or DEVICE_INDEPENDENT

printBlankPages.description: Print blank pages (General > Print Blank Pages)

printGuidesGrids.description: Print visible guides and baseline grids (General > Print Visible Guides and Baseline Grids)

printMasterPages.description: Print parent pages instead of document pages (General > Print Parent Pages)

printNonprinting.description: Print objects marked nonprinting (General > Print Non-printing Objects)

printSpreads.description: Print each spread on one sheet (General > Spreads)

printer.description: Printer name, as listed by get_print_settings (General > Printer); or POSTSCRIPT_FILE

profile.description: Printer profile name (Color Management > Printer Profile); POSTSCRIPT_CMS lets the PostScript printer manage colours, NO_CMS lets the printer; or USE_DOCUMENT / WORKING / POSTSCRIPT_CMS / NO_CMS

registrationMarks.description: Registration marks (Marks and Bleed > Registration Marks)

reverseOrder.description: Print pages in reverse order (General > Reverse Order)

scaleMode.description: Scale by width and height, or scale to fit (Setup > Scale)

screening.description: Screening name from the PPD, as listed by get_print_settings (Output > Screening); or DEFAULT_VALUE / CUSTOM

sendImageData.description: Image data sent (Graphics > Images: Send Data)

sequence.description: All pages, even pages or odd pages (General > Sequence)

simulateOverprint.description: Simulate overprint in composite output (Output > Simulate Overprint)

sourceSpace.description: Print the document or a proof (Color Management > Print: Document / Proof)

textAsBlack.description: Print all text as black (Output > Text as Black)

tilingType.description: Tiling: Auto, Auto Justified or Manual (Setup > Tile)

trapping.description: Trapping for separations: off, application built-in or Adobe In-RIP (Output > Trapping)

useDocumentBleedToPrint.description: Use the document's bleed settings (Marks and Bleed > Use Document Bleed Settings)

yellowAngle.description: Yellow screen angle, degrees (Output > Inks > Angle) (0 to 360)

yellowFrequency.description: Yellow screen frequency, lpi (Output > Inks > Frequency) (1 to 500)

name: manage_print_preset
title: Manage Print Preset
